en.headline: Uber to shut down FlyTaxi app by end of year
en.dek: The ride-hailing company said it will fully integrate the metered-taxi platform it acquired earlier this year into its own service, following the earlier closure of HKTaxi.
body: Uber said on Friday that it will shut down the standalone FlyTaxi app by the end of the year and fully integrate the metered-taxi booking service into its own platform.

FlyTaxi, a 13-year-old local taxi-hailing app, was acquired by Uber earlier in 2026. An Uber spokesman said the integration aims to provide optimal support for drivers and users. The company will guide riders and drivers through the transition to ensure continuous service.
Uber said points accumulated on the FlyTaxi app and account balances would be fully refunded. Drivers were encouraged to switch to Uber, where they would have access to a larger client base.

The move follows Uber’s earlier acquisition and subsequent shutdown of HKTaxi. The company previously said both platforms would continue to operate after the FlyTaxi purchase, but the integration now brings the second local taxi app under a single Uber service.

zh.headline: Uber年底前關閉飛的App 整合至旗下平台
zh.dek: Uber周五表示，將於年底前全面整合早前收購的本地的士叫車平台「飛的」，獨立App將停止服務。
body: Uber周五表示，將於今年年底前關閉獨立運作的「飛的」（FlyTaxi）App，並把該的士叫車服務全面整合至Uber平台。
「飛的」是營運13年的本地的士叫車應用程式，今年較早時被Uber收購。Uber發言人表示，整合旨在為司機及用戶提供最佳支援，團隊會協助乘客及司機過渡，確保服務不中斷。
Uber指，「飛的」App內累積的積分及帳戶結餘將全數退還，並鼓勵司機轉用Uber，以接觸更大客戶群及獲得更多收入機會。
事件繼Uber早前收購並關閉HKTaxi之後再進一步整合。Uber收購「飛的」時曾表示兩平台會繼續運作，現時整合後第二個本地的士App亦將納入單一Uber服務。
